commands.name: flush
commands.desc: clear all previous script commands on ent
commands.raw: [I_FLUSH] flush();//# clear all previous script commands on ent

commands.name: if
commands.desc: if condition true, execute block of commands
commands.raw: [I_IF] if ( $exp1$, $ < > ! = $, $exp2$ ) {}	//# if condition true, execute block of commands

commands.name: else
commands.desc: must immediately follow and else, will execute if the if condition is false
commands.raw: [I_IF] else () {} //# must immediately follow and else, will execute if the if condition is false

commands.name: loop
commands.desc: execute block of commands any number of times (-1 = forever)
commands.raw: [I_LOOP] loop ( %d=-1 ) {}	//# execute block of commands any number of times (-1 = forever)

commands.name: affect
commands.desc: switch script affect to ent with specified name, flush old commands or insert the new block of commands into current commands
commands.raw: affect( %s="DEFAULT", %t="AFFECT_TYPE" )  {}//# switch script affect to ent with specified name, flush old commands or insert the new block of commands into current commands

commands.name: run
commands.desc: ent runs specified script
commands.raw: run ( %s="DEFAULT" ); //# ent runs specified script

commands.name: wait
commands.desc: script will wait specified number of milliseconds
commands.raw: [I_WAITCLOCK] wait( %f=1000.0 );//# script will wait specified number of milliseconds

commands.name: waitsignal
commands.desc: wait until a signal() command is given with the name name - only one ent can wait for a particular signal
commands.raw: [I_WAITSIGNAL] waitsignal( %s="signalname" );//# wait until a signal() command is given with the name name - only one ent can wait for a particular signal

commands.name: signal
commands.desc: The ent waiting for this signal will continue with it's script
commands.raw: [I_SIGNAL] signal( %s="signalname" );//# The ent waiting for this signal will continue with it's script

commands.name: sound
commands.desc: play sound on specified channel of ent
commands.raw: [I_SOUND] sound( %t="CHANNELS", %s="FILENAME" );//# play sound on specified channel of ent

commands.name: move
commands.desc: move ent from point to point at speed
commands.raw: [I_MOVE] move ( %v=<0.0 0.0 0.0>, %v=<0.0 0.0 0.0>, %f=1000.0 );//move ent from point to point at speed

commands.name: move
commands.desc: move ent from point to point at speed
commands.raw: [I_MOVE] move ( $default$, $default$ );//move ent from point to point at speed

commands.name: rotate
commands.desc: rotate ent to target angles at speed
commands.raw: [I_ROTATE] rotate( %v=<0.0 0.0 0.0>, %f=1000.0 );//# rotate ent to target angles at speed

commands.name: use
commands.desc: uses specified ent
commands.raw: use ( %s="DEFAULT" );//# uses specified ent

commands.name: use
commands.desc: uses specified ent from a get(STRING) command
commands.raw: use ( $get(STRING,"targetname")$ );//# uses specified ent from a get(STRING) command

commands.name: kill
commands.desc: kills ent with specified name
commands.raw: kill ( %s="DEFAULT" );//# kills ent with specified name

commands.name: remove
commands.desc: removes ent with specified name from game
commands.raw: [I_REMOVE] remove ( %s="DEFAULT" ); //# removes ent with specified name from game

commands.name: print
commands.desc: Prints text to center of screen
commands.raw: print( %s="DEFAULT" );//# Prints text to center of screen

commands.name: rem
commands.desc: Just a comment for script, no actual effect in-game
commands.raw: rem(%s="comment");//# Just a comment for script, no actual effect in-game

commands.name: declare
commands.desc: declare a global variable here, limit of 16 per map
commands.raw: declare( %t="DECLARE_TYPE", %s="variablename" );	//# declare a global variable here, limit of 16 per map

commands.name: free
commands.desc: free a global variable so you can make more
commands.raw: free( %s="variablename" );	//# free a global variable so you can make more

commands.name: set
commands.desc: standard set commands
commands.raw: [I_SET] set( %t="SET_TYPES", %s="DEFAULT" );//# standard set commands

commands.name: set
commands.desc: set for variables
commands.raw: [I_SET] set( %s="variablename", %s="value" );//# set for variables

commands.name: camera
commands.raw: [I_CAMERA] camera( %t="CAMERA_COMMANDS" );

commands.name: task
commands.raw: task( %s="DEFAULT" ) {}

commands.name: do
commands.raw: [I_DO] do( %s="DEFAULT" )

commands.name: wait
commands.desc: wait until task "taskname" is complete
commands.raw: [I_WAIT] wait( %s="DEFAULT" )		//# wait until task "taskname" is complete

commands.name: dowait
commands.desc: shorthand form of:   do("taskname");      wait("taskname")
commands.raw: [I_DOWAIT] dowait( %s="DEFAULT" );	//# shorthand form of:   do("taskname");      wait("taskname")

commands.name: play
commands.raw: play (%t="PLAY_TYPES", %s="default");
